statements.text:
The literature check caught an important overlap: Dal Maso–Fonseca–Leoni–Morini already gave the degree-preserving extension in 2003. I’ll use it as a known tool.

The application I’m developing keeps the original general-\(U\) coupling and calculates a finite quartic correction that controls it on actual gradients. That would strengthen the coupled problem while leaving the uncorrected density’s status explicit.
